method: Walked the lightbox fixes on the dev server from branch worktree-agent-a0194f296a7aecb72. Page boundary, cold album kqGRRG (100 photos): stepping 44 to 48 by the Next button, then Next at 48/100; page 2 was prefetched about 6s before the boundary and photo 49 was painted within 300ms of the click (live production before the fix: ~2.0s of an invisible image and a spinner on cold album RFsHZ8, over 5s on Re7kho). Trending rail on Re7kho: a rail card opens the shared Lightbox at 3/12 without leaving the page, Next goes to 4/12 and Previous back to 3/12. Share page bd558119 (Re7kho, 120 photos): Next at 48/120 now advances to 49/120 and the photo renders (before: silent no-op). 390px: a rail tap opens the full-screen lightbox at 1/12 with Next visible; document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. Not walked by this reviewer: timeline period boundaries, month and collection continuation, explore arrow-key fix, the load-failure retry banner, and swipe gestures; those rest on the implementer's live checks and the Playwright specs added in tests/lightbox.spec.ts.
scope: album page boundary 48 to 49 on a cold album
trending rail opens the shared lightbox with next and prev
timeline, month, collections, explore, failure banner and swipe not walked by this reviewer
